$description: Orrery motion: the dialled Iris springs, promoted from src/motion.ts. Outside the Artifact contract. DTCG has no spring type, so springs sit under $extensions, the way the Phase 0 test spring does in core.tokens.json. Each spring is stored in the form it was dialled in. Each spring also declares `$reduced`, its form under prefers-reduced-motion: `opacity` (a crossfade, DESIGN.md Motion Principles 7; src/Root.tsx:303-305 jumps collapseProgress), `none` (the element has no motion of its own; src/Shared.tsx:31 drops layoutId) or `instant` (seated with no spring; src/Trigger.tsx:556-558). Never hand-edit a value: re-dial on /tune, change src/motion.ts, then this file; tokens/motion.test.mjs fails while the two differ.

iris-open.$description: Iris open: the trigger grows into the sheet.

iris-close.$description: Iris close: the sheet shrinks back into the trigger. Slightly underdamped, so it overshoots a few px at the end.

iris-shared-open.$description: Shared element while Iris opens. Stiff and near-critically damped, so it clears the growing sheet without overshoot.

iris-shared-close.$description: Shared element while Iris closes. Dialled as a set with iris-close and the 35ms lead delay.

iris-snap.$description: Trigger snapping to its anchor when a drag ends. Near critically damped (damping ratio about 0.98).
